items.title: Ontario could avoid recession this year, even as Trump's tariffs take hold: fiscal watchdog
items.description: Ontario’s fiscal watchdog says the province could avoid a recession this year, but the findings of his latest report show the trade war with the U.S. is taking a bite out of Ontario’s economy. The data is part of the latest update from the province’s Financial Accountability Office.
